title: Read the Current, Move With It
purpose: Lock the movement-led Guide Threshold traversal and preserve valid release eligibility across the response-to-settle handoff so ambient Scar-Flow drift cannot strand completion.

stages.guideLine: The scar does not block the way; it bends the current.
stages.objectiveLine: Approach the pale current where memory and pressure meet.
stages.nextAction: Move close enough for the current to read your presence.

stages.guideLine: Ask once. Watch which way the answer travels.
stages.objectiveLine: Pulse once to reveal the current's direction.
stages.nextAction: Press X once; do not absorb the scar.

stages.guideLine: Do not point at the route. Move until your motion agrees with it.
stages.objectiveLine: Move along the lit current until the fold accepts your direction.
stages.nextAction: Use left-stick up and steer with the camera; keep moving along the current.

stages.guideLine: Carry the resonance through motion. Stillness cannot open this reading.
stages.objectiveLine: Hold LT while continuing through the current.
stages.nextAction: Keep moving with the current while stabilizing with LT. X remains pulse.

stages.guideLine: The threshold is tissue changing state, not a door.
stages.objectiveLine: Watch the fold answer around your movement.
stages.nextAction: Stay with the response; no extra input is needed.

stages.guideLine: Let go where the current becomes quiet.
stages.objectiveLine: Release LT near the settling ribs and remain with the tissue.
stages.nextAction: Release resonance and hold position until the fold settles.

stages.guideLine: You crossed by agreeing with the living route.
stages.objectiveLine: The Guide Threshold reading is complete.
stages.nextAction: Let the settled fold become Signal Chorus tissue.
